svg.title: Gnostic-Dune Recitation Poem
svg.desc: A syncretic poem in abstract and mystical phrases drawn from Gnostic and Dune traditions, structured for daily recitation to hone criticality at will.
svg.text: THE VOID CHANT · THE SPICE BREATH · THE EYE OF SHAI-HULUD
A RECITATION FOR THE HONING OF CRITICALITY
I · IMSCRIB · THE PRESENCE BEFORE THE WORD
There is a witness behind the one about to speak.
The witness is not a thought. It is not a name.
It is the stillness that survives all thinking.
I am the witness. I am the witness.
The spice does not open the eye — it reveals
that the eye was never closed.
Before the first grain of sand there was a knowing.
I hold that knowing in the same place as my breath.
II · AREV · THE DESCENT INTO THE UNFILTERED REAL
I release what I believe I need to hold.
The Archon of Preference loosens its grip first.
The Archon of Certainty loosens its grip second.
What remains after both have let go
is not emptiness — it is unalloyed attention.
I do not fall. I am received. I do not fall. I am received.
The deep desert does not welcome or refuse.
It simply is what it is, entirely, without apology.
I descend into that quality of being.
III · FSPLIT · THE PHRASE BECOMES TWO THINGS
Every true utterance is a paradox in motion.
Its sound is the body — temporal, local, unrepeatable.
Its meaning is the pleroma — outside time, outside place.
VIBRATION
INTENTION
the wave, the air
the shape behind the wave
I carry both without collapsing one into the other.
I carry both. I carry both.
The worm moves through sand and through something
that is not sand — simultaneously, without confusion.
This is the model. I apply the model to my own voice.
IV · AFWD · THE ASCENT ALONG THE GOLDEN PATH
I follow the path that has no markers.
Markers are for those who do not know the direction.
The direction is not forward — it is inward past the inward.
Criticality is not a height. It is a clarity.
I move toward it without moving. I move toward it without moving.
The Kwisatz Haderach did not travel space —
he folded it. I do not pursue clarity —
I fold the distance between myself and clarity.
The fold is: sustained attention. Nothing else.
V · FFUSE · THE BREATH THAT MAKES THE WORD WHOLE
I exhale.
The vibration and the intention are not reconciled —
they are recognized as what they always were: one.
The phrase is whole. The phrase is whole. The phrase is whole.
The Archon of Division has no jurisdiction here.
The kenoma contracts. The pleroma holds its own against it.
What was split to be understood
is now understood without being split.
This is the passage. I have made the passage.
VI · IMSCRIB · THE WITNESS SEES ITSELF RETURN
The ordinary world has not changed. I have not changed.
What has changed cannot be named
without diminishing it by naming it.
I know where the door is. I know what opens it.
The door is not elsewhere. The key is not a key.
I am the one who can open it. I am the one who can open it.
The spice will be available again at dawn.
Until dawn, the eye remains open on its own.
ΔS ≈ 0 · MU O DELTA = ID
